en: Paṭṭhānapakaraṇa:
Dhammapaccanīya (2). Tikadukapaṭṭhānapāḷi (4). 10.9.
Kusala-ttika, Piṭṭhi-duka.

Dependent on a non-wholesome state that is not to be abandoned by vision … pe … dependent on a non-wholesome state that is not to be abandoned by non-vision … pe … dependent on a non-wholesome state that is not to be abandoned by cultivation … pe … dependent on a non-wholesome state that is not to be abandoned by non-cultivation … pe … [dependent on] a non-wholesome state whose root is not to be abandoned by vision … pe.

Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor rooted in wrong view to be abandoned by vision … dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor rooted in what is to be abandoned by cultivation … (Abbreviated. Under root-condition there are twenty-nine;
under object-condition there are twenty-four … under result-condition there are nine … under non-disappearance there are twenty-nine.

Dependent on a non-wholesome state whose root is to be abandoned by development … dependent on a non-wholesome state without applied thought … [and so on] … dependent on a non-wholesome state without sustained thought … [abbreviated].
Under the root condition there are twenty-four; under the object condition … [and so on].
Seventeen ... [and so on] ... nine in the case of resultants ... twenty-four in the case of non-disappearance.

Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor without sustained application ... [Abbreviated. Under the root condition there are twenty-four ... [and so on] ... nine in the case of resultants ... twenty-four in the case of non-disappearance.
Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor accompanied by zest ... dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor without zest ... [and so on].

… pe … dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor accompanied by rapture … pe … dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor not accompanied by rapture … pe … dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor accompanied by pleasure … pe … dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor not accompanied by pleasure … pe … dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor accompanied by equanimity … (Abbreviated.)

With respect to the root condition (*hetu*), there are twenty-nine; with respect to the object condition (*ārammaṇa*), twenty-four … pe … with respect to the result condition (*vipāka*), nine … pe … with respect to the non-disappearance condition (*avigata*), twenty-nine.

Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome (*akusala*) nor accompanied by equanimity (*na-upekkhā-sahagata*) … (Abbreviated. With respect to the root condition, twenty-four … pe … with respect to the result condition, nine … pe … with respect to the non-disappearance condition, twenty-four.

Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor belonging to the sense sphere (*nakāmāvacara*) … (Abbreviated. With respect to the root condition, seventeen … pe … with respect to the result condition, nine … pe … with respect to the non-disappearance condition, seventeen.

Dependent on a non-wholesome state that is neither of the sense-sphere nor of the fine-material sphere … (Abbreviated. Under root: twenty-nine; under object: twenty-four … pe … under result: nine … pe … under non-disappearance: twenty-nine.

Dependent on a non-wholesome state that is neither of the fine-material sphere … pe … dependent on a non-wholesome state that is neither of the fine-material sphere nor of the immaterial sphere … pe … dependent on a non-wholesome state that is neither of the immaterial sphere … (Abbreviated. Under root: twenty-nine.
With respect to object (ārammaṇa), twenty-four; ... [etc. ... with respect to result (vipāka), nine; ... [etc. ...

with respect to non-disappearance (avigata), twenty-nine. Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor immaterial-sphere (nakusala-nānā-rūpāvacara) ... [Abbreviated. With respect to root-cause (hetu), seventeen; ... [etc. ... with respect to result, nine; ... [etc. ... with respect to non-disappearance, seventeen.

Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor included (napariyāpanna) ... [Abbreviated. With respect to root-cause, seventeen; ... [etc. ... with respect to repetition (āsevana), nine; ... [etc. ... with respect to result, nine; ... [etc. ... with respect to non-disappearance, seventeen.

Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor included [in the mundane], ... (Abbreviated. Under root-condition: twenty-nine; under object-condition: twenty-four ... pe ... under result-condition: nine ... pe ...

under non-disappearance-condition: twenty-nine. Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor leading to liberation, ... (Abbreviated. Under root-condition: twenty-nine; under object-condition: twenty-four ... pe ... under result-condition: nine ... pe ...
under non-disappearance-condition: twenty-nine. Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor not leading to liberation, ... (In all cases: nine. There is no result-condition.)

Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor of indeterminate destiny … (Abbreviated. Under root condition there are twenty-nine; under object condition, twenty-four … pe … under result condition, nine … pe … under non-disappearance condition, twenty-nine.
Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor of indeterminate destiny … Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor surpassable … (Abbreviated.
Under root condition there are seventeen … pe … under repetition condition, nine … pe … under result condition, nine … pe … under non-disappearance condition, seventeen.

Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor unsurpassed, [a state arises] … (Abbreviated. Under the root condition there are twenty-nine; under the object condition, twenty-four … pe … under the result condition, nine … pe … under the non-disappearance condition, twenty-nine.
Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor a refuge, a state that is neither wholesome nor a refuge arises by way of the root condition.
Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor a refuge, a state that is unwholesome but not a refuge arises by way of the root condition.

Dependent on a state that is neither unwholesome nor a refuge, there arise states that are neither unwholesome nor a refuge and states that are neither wholesome nor a refuge by way of root condition.
Dependent on a state that is neither unwholesome nor a refuge, there arises a state that is neither unwholesome nor a refuge by way of root condition … five [ways].
Dependent on a state that is neither-indeterminate-nor-secure, a state that is neither-indeterminate-nor-secure arises by way of root condition ... five.

Dependent on a state that is neither-unwholesome-nor-secure and a state that is neither-indeterminate-nor-secure, a state that is neither-unwholesome-nor-secure arises by way of root condition ... five.

Dependent on a state that is neither-unwholesome-nor-secure and a state that is neither-unwholesome-nor-secure, a state that is neither-unwholesome-nor-secure arises by way of root condition ... three. (Abbreviated.)

In the case of root-condition (*hetu*), twenty-one; in the case of object-condition (*ārammaṇa*), seventeen ... pe ... in the case of resultant-condition (*vipāka*), nine; in the case of non-disappearance-condition (*avigata*), twenty-one. (The full detail for all [conditions] follows.

Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor unwholesome (*na-kusala na-akusala*), there arises a state that is neither wholesome nor unwholesome by way of root-condition. (Abbreviated. In the case of root-condition, nine ... pe ... in the case of non-disappearance-condition, nine.
The "Backbone-Duo" of the Wholesome Triplet (*kusalattika-piṭṭhiduka*) is finished.
